title: LBI Family Overview
headline: One light. Unlimited possibilities — connect up to 40 from one power feed*
callouts: One light. Unlimited possibilities — connect up to 40 from one power feed*
Easiest install ever — more time to chill
LBI — linkable light bar w/ an internal driver. Switch between 3 wattages + 3 CCTs
LBI G2 — linkable light bar w/ an internal driver. Tunable white. More CCTs. More lumens
LBI 65 — linkable light bar w/ an internal driver. IP65-rated. More CCTs. More lumens
LBI MAX — linkable strip fixture w/ an internal driver. More CCTs. Even higher lumens

features.label: Linkable — up to 40 units from one power feed
features.note: * Connect up to 30 4 ft LBI or LBI 65 units, or 20 4 ft LBI MAX units, at 120VAC
